hints.title: Grammar Operations
hints.text: The grammar has two main operations: union represented by comma separation, and Cartesian product represented by sequential concatenation.

hints.title: Precedence Handling
hints.text: Concatenation binds tighter than comma union. Group concatenated sets at the current depth before uniting them across commas.

hints.title: Balancing Nested Braces
hints.text: Track brace nesting level: when encountering a top-level brace pair, recursively expand the inner substring and treat its output as a single term in concatenation.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple replacements break on deeply nested braces or mix up concatenation and comma precedence.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Depth-zero grouping parses expressions cleanly and forms Cartesian products hierarchically.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should clearly identify operator precedence (concatenation before union) and handle balanced nested expressions.
complexity.notes: Final output words must be sorted in lexicographical order with duplicates removed.
